answer: Put blinded token issuance with double-spend detection at the door and most farms never get in: the check itself is the filter. A farm running 554 aliases would need 554 separate proofs, each costing about 116 POA or 18 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. The terrace of the design is public, the willow of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the canyon of honest work is what finally pays. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
